_note: Positions + proper motions used by fetch_cutouts.py (no SIMBAD needed). coord_epoch = the epoch the ra/dec refer to; the pipeline propagates to each SPHEREx date. pmra is mu_alpha*cos(dec) in mas/yr. Anton: verify against Gaia DR3 / literature.

targets.label: WISE 0855
targets.pm_ref: Wikipedia / Kirkpatrick et al. 2021. Position = WISE designation (2010 data); consistent with CatWISE J085508.34-071439.2 at ~2015.4
targets.blurb: Coldest known brown dwarf, about 8 arcsec/yr. Faint; brightest near 4.5-5 um (detectors 5-6).

targets.label: Barnard's Star
targets.blurb: Fastest proper motion of any star, about 10 arcsec/yr. Bright: expect saturation flags.

targets.label: Epsilon Indi B
targets.pm_ref: Wikipedia (eps Ind Ba/Bb). Position approximate, verify
targets.blurb: Brown-dwarf pair Ba/Bb a few arcminutes from Epsilon Indi A; about 4.7 arcsec/yr.

targets.label: RW Aurigae
targets.blurb: Young variable star; brightness changes between visits.

targets.label: R Draconis
targets.blurb: Mira-type variable; rises and falls over months.
